finding: The initial homepage fixture times out waiting for the settings modal to disappear after a single Escape. The failure screenshot was individually inspected and retains the modal with its close control focused. The existing shared dismissModalWithEscape helper explicitly handles an active in-modal tooltip before closing its parent modal. This fixture will adopt that existing semantic dismissal; no operation timeout or product behavior is changed. The failure alone does not prove a product modal defect or diagnose the earlier low-contrast homepage.
